summary: Dose entry windows now share a wider map-based location form.

minor_improvements: Add dose, missed dose, and edit dose windows now use a shared two-column form on desktop.
Dose locations can be selected from search suggestions, current location, saved home location, or by dropping a pin on the map.
Phone-sized sheets keep the same controls in a scrollable single-column layout.
bug_fixes: Manually selected map locations no longer store invalid location accuracy values.
